reported_status: Every finite quantum-channel class with the same COMPLETE maximal-information profiles has a GREATEST MEMBER under deterministic output processing. Complete RLD profiles are equivalent to ordered normalized-output moments and an input-labelled,state-preserving star-isomorphism of the generated finite algebra with its faithful state. A canonical representative attains minimum output dimension sum_j n_j. For EXPLICIT RATIONAL CHOI MATRIX input,the producer constructs deterministic polynomial-bit equality testing,a polynomial-size rational GREATEST-CHANNEL compiler,and rational physical converters. The finite-grid inequality-witness construction provides faithful rational states,finite reference and exact margin;NO ADDITIONAL POLYNOMIAL WITNESS-GENERATION bound is inferred;the polynomial rational output may be larger than the exact algebraically minimal representative. This does not evaluate ordinary quantum capacity or settle its unrestricted approximation problem.

The greatest channel is a MEMBER of its class and structurally maximizes every output-processing-monotone capacity,but its numerical capacity is unevaluated. Smallest algebraic output and polynomial rational enlarged output must not be conflated. Nontracial faithful state and ordered products are essential. Synthesizing Gamma from a channel description does not freely upgrade an existing device. Heralding permits assisted positivity with paid retries/communication,not ordinary unassisted rate or arbitrary unknown-input retries. Environment equivalence,not input-independent success alone,earns key-security transfer. Robustness uses the supplied diamond-error and fixed memoryless/local-operation conventions.
